items.title: Joe Loyacano Interview, 1959-08-20
items.q: man I remember one night, he come and we had a four piece job. In a house, a house party. And they sent him on bass.

ctx.s: Mrs. Joe Loyacano (wife of Joe Loyacano)
ctx.x: They run a tobacco service on Decatur Street, you know, for cigarette machines.

Yeah. Yeah. Well, Fanats was a big heavy set man himself. Uh huh. But he blew a sousaphone and it sounded like a bass fiddle. Right. But he not a sousaphone but upright bass. It sounded just like a, man I remember one night, he come and we had a four piece job. In a house, a house party. And they sent him on bass. They come in there with this big bass horn. Jesus Christ, what are you gonna do in here? You blow the walls off this place. Don't worry, everything will be alright. He said, don't worry about nothing.…
Uh, who did he work with? Oh, Fanats?
